independentKissingerDecimal50.description: Independent 5-rate Kissinger peak benchmark with coordinates distinct from KAS

singleStepControl.name: single-step-control
singleStepControl.description: Single-step first-order ODE control (Ea = 120 kJ/mol, A = 1e10 min^-1); expects REPORTABLE with no variation warning.

parallelModerateVariation.name: parallel-moderate-variation
parallelModerateVariation.description: Two parallel first-order reactions (w1=0.5, E1=108 kJ/mol, A1=5e9 min^-1; w2=0.5, E2=126 kJ/mol, A2=5e10 min^-1); expects POSSIBLE_MULTISTEP_EA_VARIATION (10-20%) on all four methods and INTEGRAL_METHOD_VARIABLE_EA_BIAS on integral methods only.

parallelStrongVariation.name: parallel-strong-variation
parallelStrongVariation.description: Two parallel first-order reactions (w1=0.5, E1=80 kJ/mol, A1=1e7 min^-1; w2=0.5, E2=160 kJ/mol, A2=1e13 min^-1); expects MULTISTEP_EA_VARIATION (>20%), INTEGRAL_METHOD_VARIABLE_EA_BIAS on integral methods, and meanEaRecommended=false.

consecutiveStrongVariation.name: consecutive-strong-variation
consecutiveStrongVariation.description: Two consecutive first-order reactions A->B->C (w1=0.5, E1=80 kJ/mol, A1=1e7 min^-1; w2=0.5, E2=160 kJ/mol, A2=1e13 min^-1); expects MULTISTEP_EA_VARIATION (>20%) and INTEGRAL_METHOD_VARIABLE_EA_BIAS on integral methods.
